correctness.rationale: The Cauchy–Binet minors of rows (1,1),(e^{-at},e^{-bt}),(e^{-aT},e^{-bT}) give F=x²(1−u)²+q²(1−v)²+q²x²(u−v)². Its derivative in x is 2x Q_T(u), with Q(v)=(1−v)(1−rv) and Q(1)=q²(1−v)(r−v). The convex quadratic has one interior minimum when T≤Tc and two interior critical points (one unique global maximum) when T>Tc; endpoints exactly tie. Q(1/r)>0 with Q′(1/r)<0 gives t*<Tc, and the two critical limits equal Tc, so nonmonotonicity holds. For T→∞, F(t*)→r^{-2/(r−1)}(1−1/r)², while endpoint value decays as 2e^{-2aT}, giving the stated ratio. Independently checked 20 rate/horizon parameter pairs against 1001 grid points and exact quadratic candidates; finite grids are only diagnostics.
